package: TreeVar ATANH exact-real-axis branch, JAX-only eager numeric evaluation
source_contract: TreeVar numeric ATANH uses native numeric primitive. R2025b captured exact real-axis branch is sign(real)*pi/2 outside [-1,1], independent of imaginary signed-zero storage; nonzero lips retain usual complex branch. Chebfun7574 supplies dispatch context, not builtin implementation source.
implementation: JAX real-axis identity atanh(1/x) outside domain, assembled via lax.complex. Real kernel uses sign(t)*log1p(2abs(t)/(1-abs(t)))/2; pure imaginary identity i*atan(y); remaining complex inputs use JAX complex atanh. Actual _UNARY_FNS mapping bypasses complex fallback.
